start: A messenger note directs the player to a cliff entrance near the Ancient Guthixian Temple in the Chasm of Tears. The miniquest starts on first attempt to enter the Archive lobby. Ride a light creature down using a lit sapphire lantern.

prerequisites.required: While Guthix Sleeps complete (tracker still Pending; modeled as flag.archive.while_guthix_sleeps_complete_external until upstream integration)
prerequisites.item: Lit sapphire lantern to attract the light creature; this item already exists in the Tears of Guthix catalog.
prerequisites.combat: Difficult group raid with powerful bosses; combat gear, food and potions recommended; no unsupported hard Combat-level check applied.

stage_flow: Reach Chasm of Tears on a light creature and enter the Archive lobby; first entry unlocks access before the miniquest itself is complete.
Assemble a group of one to eight players (alone uses two-player scaling), consult General Montoya and begin a raid.
Fight either Ezekiel or Bork and the Smorks (exclusive second encounter).
Fight either Moia or Dreadnoth the Jellied (exclusive third encounter).
Quartermaster appears after the third boss; optional supplies cannot be assumed free and are not granted by the planner.
Fight either Xarth or the Dagon'hai Elder and monks (exclusive fourth encounter).
Defeat Ocellus (mandatory final fifth encounter), completing the miniquest's first full clear.
Use The Blade to travel to personal raid reward chests; reward amounts and unique drops are randomized and have no fixed quest-completion allocation. Return to lobby.

rewards.on_start: Raid lobby and repeatable raid access unlock.
rewards.on_first_clear: Miniquest completion flag only; no deterministic item, Archivist's Folio or XP.
rewards.raid_chest: Variable standard and unique loot, outside scope of deterministic activity completion; Folio is a chance drop, not a reward guaranteed on first completion.

combat: Each of five fights requires an explicit successful planned outcome. A full-party wipe ends the run, gravestone/death costs apply and Hardcore Ironmen can lose status. Fight XP, deaths, supplies, party scaling and replay resets are not deterministic in this catalog.

supplies_and_transport.approach: Existing Tears of Guthix light creature and sapphire lantern references; added chasm descent, return and lobby entrances.
supplies_and_transport.rooms: Boss-choice hall abstracts each boss door and return, without treating all eight bosses as mandatory. The Blade is a gated final-arena to rewards transport.
supplies_and_transport.timing: All raid durations are estimated, highly variable by group size, gear, success and experience; no Quest Helper observations for this release.

remaining_review_gaps: While Guthix Sleeps remains a pending journal row; replace flag.archive.while_guthix_sleeps_complete_external with actual completion action once available.
